title: Doc website: Visible scrolling bars
body: **Bug: What is the current behavior?** The menu on the left has a horizontal scrollbar visible. It prevents to see all the content of the menu **Bug: What is the expected behavior?** Not to see them **Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?** FF 57

comments.body:
Thanks for opening the issue @ElPicador ! 
So, there is so far no way to hide them easily in FF. 

Right now I don't have bandwidth to take care of this, I'll do it as soon as possible. 
Meanwhile, I encourage you to check this pen! https://codepen.io/JonAnderDev/pen/XJNOPr

It's a bulletproof way to hide them on every browsers

Thanks for the insights. I agree it's not a big deal.
But, IMHO, #2666 is far more an issue. Could you have a look?

I use FF (beta) and the behavior is now similar to chrome. If it's not already the case in stable, it'll come soon.

As for the horizontal scrollbar, this is definitely doable. PR is proposed.
